## Question 2:

### Two of the `minutes` columns in the flight data have missing values. Calculate the standard deviation after replacing the missing values with the median. Report the larger standard deviation (2 decimal places).

```{python}
# Question 2 Code
print(flights)
print(flights.schema)

# Nulls in minutes_delayed_carrier and minutes_delayed_nas 
flights.null_count()
```

```{python}
# Replace missing values with median
clean_flights = (flights
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("minutes_delayed_carrier").fill_null(pl.col("minutes_delayed_carrier").median()).alias("minutes_delayed_carrier"),
    pl.col("minutes_delayed_nas").fill_null(pl.col("minutes_delayed_nas").median()).alias("minutes_delayed_nas")
  )
)

clean_flights.null_count()
```

```{python}
# Standard deviation -
# get mean
# subtract mean from main
# square that
# get average
# sqrt that

delay_cols = clean_flights.select(cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed_")).columns

# Get mean
means = (clean_flights
  .with_columns([
    pl.col(col).mean()
    .alias("mean_" + col)
    for col in delay_cols
  ])
)

means
```

```{python}
mean_cols = means.select(cs.starts_with("mean_minutes_delayed_")).columns
delay_cols = clean_flights.select(cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed_")).columns

all_cols = list(zip(delay_cols, mean_cols))

# Subtract mean from main and square it
subs = (means
  .with_columns([
    ((pl.col(col) - pl.col(mean)) ** 2)
    .alias("sub_" + col)
    for col, mean in all_cols
  ])
)

subs

```

```{python}
diff_cols = subs.select(cs.starts_with("sub_minutes_delayed_")).columns

# Variance - average those squared differences
# Take the square root of that

variance = (subs
  .with_columns([
    (np.sqrt(pl.col(col).mean()))
    .alias("var_" + col)
    for col in diff_cols
  ])
)

variance
```

```{python}
# Report the larger standard deviation (2 decimal places).
# Assuming between minutes_delayed_carrier and minutes_delayed_nas?

print(variance.select("var_sub_minutes_delayed_carrier", "var_sub_minutes_delayed_nas").head(1))

print("Largest is minutes_delayed_nas at 84662.95")

```
